paragraph: [Conecta Angola, launched in June 2023 for remote areas operators do not serve, had reached more than 300,000 people by October 2024](<https://minttics.gov.ao/ao/noticias/angosat-2-alcanca-mais-de-300-mil-angolanos-sem-acesso-as-telecomunicacoes/>). In the last twelve months, [on 20 October 2026 the President authorised US$50 million and a tender for the Programa Conectividade](<https://pti.ao/executivo-disponibiliza-50-milhoes-de-dolares-e-abre-concurso-para-execucao-do-programa-conectividade/>). [In November 2026 the ICT minister said 71 small internet providers take part in Conecta Angola](<https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/10/11/2026/angola-seeks-stronger-technology-investment-ties-with-qatar-minister>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[In August 2026 the regulator ARCT said a new universal service fund will help rural people reach the internet](<https://www.iwacu-burundi.org/englishnews/number-of-internet-users-in-burundi-is-low-says-arct/>). [SETIC signed a $5.9 million contract with ONATEL for 92 rural hills lacking 2G or 3G](<https://www.burunditimes.com/5-9m-onatel-deal-marks-new-push-for-digital-access-in-rural-burundi/>), which is expected to serve about 372,000 people. [PAFEN and Lumitel signed a USD 10 million contract for rural 4G, 44 per cent paid by the government](<https://setic.gov.bi/connectivite-numerique-haut-debit-4g-en-milieu-rural/>). No site connected under these contracts has been found in the last twelve months. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a programme to connect rural areas is under way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a programme to bring internet access to rural or underserved areas that the government or its universal service fund has launched, funded or prepared in the past three years.

[The ministry reported covering more than 400 new white-zone localities in 2025](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article145231>), after [138 in 2024, built with a State subsidy through the universal service fund](<https://www.sidwaya.info/couverture-des-zones-blanches-la-ministre-aminata-zerbo-inspecte-des-sites-de-telecommunications/>). In the last twelve months, [on 8 October 2026 the minister said 750 villages would get calls, internet and mobile money by end-2026](<https://refletinfo.net/telecommunications-750-villages-burkinabe-sortiront-bientot-des-zones-blanches/>). [Figures shown at a national justice forum in June 2026 put internet access at 72% in urban areas](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/burkina-faso-issues-600-000-criminal-records-online-but-rural-connectivity-gap-persists>). [In rural areas it was 27%](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/burkina-faso-issues-600-000-criminal-records-online-but-rural-connectivity-gap-persists>). No household survey or statistics office figure since October 2023 has been found for internet use in rural and urban areas. Operating would need such a survey or statistics office figure of the past three years.

[The Universal Access and Service Fund had connected 279 villages to 4G by March 2025](<https://www.bocra.org.bw/sites/default/files/sites/default/files/documents/UASF_Annual_Report_2024_25_WEB.pdf>), and [aims at full rural connectivity by 2029](<https://www.bocra.org.bw/sites/default/files/sites/default/files/documents/UASF_Annual_Report_2024_25_WEB.pdf>). [In May 2025 the state fibre operator BoFiNet said it had connected 223 of 503 gazetted villages with fibre](<https://www.bwtechzone.com/2025/05/how-bofinet-plans-to-transform-botswana.html>). In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the ministry said the village connectivity project still extends internet to rural communities](<https://itweb.africa/article/botswana-taps-huawei-for-ai-rural-connectivity/GxwQDq1DOk9MlPVo>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[In July 2025 the body that oversees the universal service fund began work](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1107-130013-centrafrique-vers-la-mise-en-uvre-du-fonds-du-service-universel>). [The fund is funded by 2% of operator revenue](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1107-130013-centrafrique-vers-la-mise-en-uvre-du-fonds-du-service-universel>), and operators are to build the infrastructure in uncovered areas. In the last twelve months, [on 15 April 2026 the regulator ARCEP named finishing the fund a priority for 2026](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2104-137723-centrafrique-la-mise-en-uvre-effective-du-fonds-du-service-universel-prevue-pour-2026>). No site connected under the fund has been found. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In September 2025 ITU figures put internet penetration at 52.7% urban and 24.6% rural](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/telecom/cote-d-ivoire-to-extend-broadband-to-30-rural-towns-by-end-september>). [Phase one of the rural connectivity programme, finished in 2024, built 160 radio sites in 175 localities for about 221,000 people](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/cote-d-ivoire-68-millions-pour-connecter-575-localites-rurales>). In the last twelve months, [a government communique of 24 August 2026 said the FCFA 38 billion programme continues towards 575 localities](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/cote-d-ivoire-68-millions-pour-connecter-575-localites-rurales>). [In August 2026 the agency ANSUT said 70% of rural households have no internet](<https://digitalmag.ci/parlons-projet-gilles-thierry-beugre-devoile-le-plan-strategique-2026-2030-de-lansut/>). No source found since October 2023 puts rural internet use at four-fifths of the urban rate or more. Mature would need rural internet use of 80 per cent or more of the urban rate, from a household survey of the past three years.

[On 8 July 2025 the posts ministry validated a national universal digital service strategy](<https://patnuc.cm/2025/07/11/numerique-pour-tous-le-cameroun-valide-sa-strategie-nationale-de-service-universel/>), aiming to cover all underserved areas by 2030. [On 31 October 2025 the posts minister opened bidding for the rural part of the World Bank-backed PATNUC](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/0911-15315-digital-divide-cameroon-aims-to-connect-328-rural-communities-by-2028>). It has 55 billion XAF for 328 localities without 3G by 2028. In the last twelve months, [by 13 November 2026 Orange had commissioned 40 of 120 white-zone sites](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/8365/orange-cameroon-commissions-rural-connectivity-sites-in-campo-beach-under-patnuc-project>). On 26 November 2026 [the minister said 67 sites had been brought into service](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/2611-17282-cameroon-urges-banks-fintechs-to-expand-digital-lending-beyond-mobile-payments>). No source found since October 2023 gives rural and urban internet use. Operating would need rural and urban use published by a household survey or the statistics office.

[On 12 February 2026 the universal service fund (FDSU) presented its National Connectivity Strategy 2026-2035](<https://www.fdsu.cd/blog/le-fdsu-presente-la-strategie-nationale-pour-la-connectivite-universelle-2026-2035-modele-towerco-lead>). It plans a subsidised, TowerCo-led roll-out in five zones and three phases to connect about 68 million rural Congolese. In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the FDSU signed subsidy agreements with Vodacom, Airtel, Africell and Orange for at least 40 towers](<https://acp.cd/economie/telecoms-une-entreprise-beneficie-de-328-millions-usd-pour-implanter-728-pylones-en-rdc/>) in peri-urban and rural areas. No count of sites already connected has been found. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In January 2026 the universal service fund FASUCE connected two localities, Miaba and Ehota](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/01/28/congo-advances-digital-inclusion-with-new-connections-in-miaba-and-ehota/>). [Its committee chair said that in five years it deployed 254 sites in 244 localities](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/miaba-et-ehota-connectees-le-fasuce-poursuit-sa-mission-dinclusion-numerique-dans-la-cuvette>). In the last twelve months, [on 26 February 2026 the PATN steering committee adopted a 2026 budget of 21.872 billion FCFA](<https://www.journaldebrazza.com/congo-plus-de-21-milliards-fcfa-pour-accelerer-la-transformation-numerique/>), with rural connectivity a 2026 priority. No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

No stage is set. [INE's 2025 continuous survey shows 22.7% of people aged 10 and over did not use the internet in the previous three months](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2026/05/28/internet-chega-a-mais-familias-rurais-do-que-urbanas-em-cabo-verde-em-2025-ine/102930>). [The same survey implies rural internet use of 68.8% against 80.0% urban](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2026/05/28/internet-chega-a-mais-familias-rurais-do-que-urbanas-em-cabo-verde-em-2025-ine/102930>), which is 86% of the urban rate. No source found says a programme to connect rural areas is under way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a programme to bring internet access to rural or underserved areas that the government or its universal service fund has launched, funded or prepared in the past three years.

[In April 2026 the regulator ARMD said a World Bank-funded mission had delivered a draft decree, a draft bylaw and an operations guide](<https://www.armd.dj/en/blog/a-feedback-meeting-of-the-final-report-regarding-the-universal-service-fund-establishment-74>). [They are to set up a Universal Service Fund for equitable access across the whole country](<https://www.armd.dj/en/blog/a-feedback-meeting-of-the-final-report-regarding-the-universal-service-fund-establishment-74>). In the last twelve months, the fund has been found only as a draft decree, and no site connected has been found. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[On 21 October 2024 the minister switched on 4G in Djelida and El Amra, in Ain Defla](<https://www.ooredoo.dz/w/tout-sur-ooredoo/communiques-de-presse/ooredoo-etend-son-reseau-dans-le-cadre-du-service-universel>). [Two ministerial orders of June 2024 had awarded the universal-service mobile lots for low-density localities](<https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2024/F2024045.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the State gave Mobilis a universal service programme for 201 4G sites in under-covered zones](<https://algerian-business.com/mobilis-4g-algerie-201-sites-27-milliards/>). [On 7 September 2026 the regulator ARPCE opened a tender to extend mobile coverage to 3,000 sparsely populated localities](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/09/algeria-tender-mobile-coverage-3000-underserved-areas/>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[By end-December 2024 the planning ministry reported fibre extended to 409 villages in the first phase of Haya Karima, the Decent Life initiative for rural Egypt](<https://moic.gov.eg/news/2042>). [Mobile coverage was completed in 901 of 1,164 villages by September 2025](<https://www.comcec.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/4.-Egypt-Presentation-on-Rural-Accessibility.pdf>), and [MCIT reports 1,180,723 buildings covered by fibre under phase one](<https://www.comcec.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/4.-Egypt-Presentation-on-Rural-Accessibility.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

A regulation that [requires Ethio Telecom and Safaricom to pay 1.5% of revenue into the Universal Access Fund](<https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/49962/>) is dated to March 2026 by The Reporter Ethiopia. It brings in about 2.5 billion Birr a year. In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 the innovation minister directed the Authority to expand connectivity in rural and underserved communities](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/28/ethiopia-telecom-regulator-service-quality-affordability/>), against measurable targets. No source found since October 2023 gives a count of rural sites, towers or people connected. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[On 16 February 2024 Arcep launched phase two of the universal service, paid for by an operator fund](<https://www.gabonreview.com/fracture-numerique-au-gabon-plus-de-117-000-habitants-nont-pas-acces-a-internet-en-2024/>), to extend coverage to 200 villages in all nine provinces. [In December 2024 ARCEP's chairman said three of 20 planned rural sites had been built and were about to enter service](<https://www.arcep.ga/pages/detail_actu/42>). In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 minister Marc Alexandre Doumba said the government would speed up the universal service](<https://legabonais.com/bilan-des-100-jours-internet-cybersecurite-administration-numerique-marc-alexandre-doumba-deroule-la-strategie-digitale/>). In October 2026 he said [more than 200 villages were still not connected](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-digital-interview-notre-ambition-est-de-faire-de-libreville-la-capitale-africaine-du-numerique-dixit-mark-alexandre-doumba/>). Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In September 2026 the minister said about 1,400 Rural Telephony Project sites carry traffic](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-upgrade-all-rural-telephony-networks-to-4g-capability-sam-george/>). [Another 300 were complete and awaiting connection, towards 2,016 sites](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-upgrade-all-rural-telephony-networks-to-4g-capability-sam-george/>). [The opposition NPP says 1,961 sites had been built by the January 2025 handover, many now not working](<https://www.citinewsroom.com/2026/09/npp-gives-communications-ministry-30-days-to-disclose-rural-telephony-status/>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 the minister said Ghana plans 800 new and 2,000 upgraded cell sites this year, with underserved areas prioritised](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/16/ghana-2800-telecom-site-builds-upgrades/>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[On 22 July 2025 the universal service agency ANSUTEN presented a study mapping white zones](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/07/guinee-vers-une-couverture-a-90-des-zones-rurales-dici-2030-une-initiative-de-lansuten/>). [It aims to cover 90% of the rural population by 2030, with a tender to follow](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/07/guinee-vers-une-couverture-a-90-des-zones-rurales-dici-2030-une-initiative-de-lansuten/>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 the deputy national director of telecommunications said Guinea's digital planning master plan targets 857 priority rural localities](<https://www.sikafinance.com/marches/connectivite-en-afrique-la-24e-reunion-du-fratel-explore-les-grands-defis-de-l-investissement-public-et-de-la-regulation_65417>). No site connected has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In April 2024 the minister said the government was embarking on initiatives for rural Gambia](<https://unctad.org/system/files/non-official-document/ecn162024_wsis_s01_Gambia_OBah_en.pdf>), including [using satellite as a source of connectivity](<https://unctad.org/system/files/non-official-document/ecn162024_wsis_s01_Gambia_OBah_en.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says whether these initiatives are delivering, and no site connected under them has been found. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In October 2025 consultants to the World Bank-financed WARDIP project delivered a strategic plan for the Universal Access and Service Fund](<https://wardip.gw/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Documento-Final-de-Validacao-do-Workshop.pdf>), known by its Portuguese initials, FAU. [It includes fibre links that extend the national backbone to less-served rural centres](<https://wardip.gw/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Documento-Final-de-Validacao-do-Workshop.pdf>), and [it proposes a pilot to subsidise phones](<https://wardip.gw/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Documento-Final-de-Validacao-do-Workshop.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No site is yet reported connected under the plan or by the fund. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In November 2023 the Vice-President ordered Huawei to draw up a project for telephone and internet coverage of the whole territory](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/la_calidad_de_la_red_telefonica_podria_mejorar_proximamente>). [It includes the interior and is to be assessed before a first phase is approved](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/la_calidad_de_la_red_telefonica_podria_mejorar_proximamente>). [In April 2023 the state infrastructure manager GITGE linked the island province of Annobon to the national fibre network](<https://news.identicge.org/annobon-ya-dispone-de-internet-de-alta-velocidad/>), by a submarine cable from Sao Tome. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 counts sites connected by a rural programme. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In August 2025 the Communications Authority said 155 of the 369 sub-locations targeted by its mobile phases 1-4 were connected](<https://www.kictanet.or.ke/major-usf-transparency-update-kenyas-communications-authority-responds-to-public-inquiry/>). [By September 2024 it had laid 1,300 km of fibre across 19 counties](<https://www.ca.go.ke/ca-lay-2500km-fibre-accross-19-counties>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 the government asked counties to name unconnected wards for the fund to target](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/government-to-partner-with-counties-to-implement-ict-related-projects-across-the-country/>). The KDHS 2022 [gave internet use by men aged 15 to 49 of 80.0% in urban and 40.7% in rural areas](<https://www.ca.go.ke/sites/default/files/2024-12/ICT-KDHS%20Analytical%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf>). It predates October 2023. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

On 26 October 2026 the Liberia Telecommunications Authority said the [Universal Access Fund already supports 15 towers](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/telecom/telecoms-le-liberia-identifie-les-zones-mal-desservies-pour-etendre-son-reseau>). It has [found sites for 15 more](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/telecom/telecoms-le-liberia-identifie-les-zones-mal-desservies-pour-etendre-son-reseau>). [In May 2025 the fund began restoring rural sites after nine of its twelve towers were found inactive for almost two years](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/telecom/0505-46729-liberia-launches-national-effort-to-restore-mobile-service-in-remote-areas>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the Authority reported a new fund tower at Vahun](<https://lta.gov.lr/boosting-connectivity-in-rural-liberia/>), and in November 2026 it said [15 remote towers were being upgraded from 2G to 4G](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202611090734.html>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use for rural areas or for urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a programme to connect rural areas is under way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a programme to bring internet access to rural or underserved areas that the government or its universal service fund has launched, funded or prepared in the past three years.

[In May 2024 a Vodacom tower at Ha-Tsepe, Leribe, paid for by the fund and the AfDB, was inaugurated](<https://www.diaspora.thepost.co.ls/2024/05/24/new-tower-for-ha-tsepe/>), and [it connects 10 villages](<https://www.diaspora.thepost.co.ls/2024/05/24/new-tower-for-ha-tsepe/>). [The Lesotho Communications Authority's annual report 2024/25 says the Universal Service Fund pays to extend telecommunications to unserved and underserved areas](<https://lca.org.ls/wp-content/uploads/filr/4278/Annual-Report-2024-25-2-1.pdf>). [In August 2025 the Community Digital Inclusion Model was launched with UNDP](<https://publiceyenews.com/2025/08/19/undp-powers-lesothos-digital-leap/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[The 2024 census found that 70.2% of urban residents aged 15 and over had used the internet in the previous three months](<https://aljarida24.ma/p/actualites/298884/>). [Among rural residents it was 40.4%](<https://aljarida24.ma/p/actualites/298884/>). [Over 10,640 rural zones gained 2G, 3G and 4G between 2018 and 2024, the minister said](<https://www.lavieeco.com/au-royaume/plan-national-du-haut-debit-un-taux-de-realisation-de-99-pour-la-premiere-phase/>). In the last twelve months, [on 20 April 2026 the minister told parliament that phase two of the national broadband plan targets 2,000 rural zones in 2026](<https://telquel.ma/instant-t/2026/04/21/plus-de-10-690-zones-couvertes-par-les-services-de-telecommunications-haut-debit-affirme-seghrouchni_1985310/>). No source found since October 2023 puts rural internet use at four-fifths of the urban rate or more. Mature would need rural internet use of 80 per cent or more of the urban rate, from a household survey of the past three years.

[In August 2025 the minister said she had launched a USD 55 million DECIM subsidy for towers and fibre in remote areas](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-stephanie-delmotte-minister-of-of-digital-development-posts-and-telecommunications-of-madagascar-mndpt>). [A pilot of 73 RuralStar sites in Menabe was announced in July 2025](<https://www.moov.mg/article/104798-extension-du-reseau-numerique-la-region-menabe-choisie-pour-tester-la-technologie-ruralstar>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the digital development minister said solutions were in place in 146 fokontany](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0707-57146-madagascar-s-parliament-calls-for-faster-network-rollout-in-underserved-areas>), under a programme that targets 3,844 fokontany. Roll-out depends on funding. No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[On 23 July 2026 the state fund AGEFAU adopted a revised programme to extend network coverage and internet access](<https://primature.ml/11e-session-ordinaire-du-conseil-dadministration-de-lagence-de-gestion-du-fonds-dacces-universel/>), with universal access centres and Wi-Fi points added. [For 2025 AGEFAU had planned FCFA 43.35bn to extend coverage and universal access centres](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1703-126707-mali-72-millions-pour-ameliorer-lacces-aux-services-telecoms-en-2025>). In the last twelve months, [its revised 2026 budget of FCFA 27.89bn keeps coverage of 162 localities](<https://agefaumali.com/archives/11e-session-ordinaire-du-conseil-dadministration-de-lagence-de-gestion-du-fonds-dacces-universel-agefau/>). No locality is yet counted as connected. Establishing would need a rural programme that has connected a stated number of sites or people.

[In August 2026 the government said it had connected 149 localities to the internet, and 418 schools](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1808-140924-inclusion-numerique-le-mozambique-veut-connecter-300-localites-aux-services-telecoms>), against a target of at least 300 localities. [In October 2025 the regulator awarded Vodacom 60 rural mobile stations with public Wi-Fi in nine provinces](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/10/20/mozambique-to-install-60-new-mobile-stations-to-boost-rural-connectivity/>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the regulator INCM said a July 2026 decree lets it turn operators' fines into universal-service duties](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2608-141049-mozambique-les-amendes-telecoms-financent-desormais-l-inclusion-numerique>). No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

[In February 2025 the regulator ARE said the universal service fund's southern border project had built 144 radio sites](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-T/Workshops-and-Seminars/2025/0217/Documents/02-Cheikh%20ARE%20Mauritania.pdf>), serving more than 400 localities. [On 28 December 2024 the President launched phases two and three, with 100 sites over 964 km](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/261984>). In the last twelve months, the digital transformation ministry [has opened digital service centres with free internet access](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2402-53224-mauritania-opens-digital-service-centers-to-expand-access-to-online-public-services>). They are in Ouadane, opened in December 2025, and Bassikounou, opened in February 2026. No source found since October 2023 gives internet use in rural and in urban areas. Operating would need rural and urban internet use published from a household survey of the past three years.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether a programme to connect rural areas is under way. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a programme to bring internet access to rural or underserved areas that the government or its universal service fund has launched, funded or prepared in the past three years.
